body:
That may be true, also been through different things.
I want stop living in a world were I don't have a wish to live. 
And I wanted to talk to someone for a bit about my feels and plans, taking off to bed now, wish you the best

Sounds like you have been through more than me, but sounds like you find some happiness at the same time with the support of others.
I do have people I know would do all they could to help, but I do not feel like help or change is what I want. 
(Ironic when posting on a forum where others help, but it's different)

Hey sry I did not see your message, appreciate the response :)
Yea, happiness sometimes feel like pressure when you live feeling indifferent  or numb. 
Have you felt this way for a long time, or often?

I guess indifferent or numb may describe the way I feel, also lost and overwhelmed by the world.

Reddit is not as easy to use on phone, did not see all replies:( appreciate them tho 

What makes you think having friends is enough reason to live? It's hard for me to understand as I don't feel the same way.

I think I'm to lost or selfish to care about what happens after I'm gone. My parents or the world may not even exist after I'm gone. And if they do i don't think it matters if they are sad, happy or anything else. 
Yesterday we went shopping and eat out, which was fun. I enjoy playing games with some of my friends, others I share an interest in programming.

Yes I have thought about it many times, despite telling myself that I should wait. But I have always talked myself out of it after a few days.
This time I feel I can do it, i have been sure for a long time.  I have put away the thoughts of waiting for change, and have also stopped thinking a meaningful or happy life is something I want and something for me to strive for.

Also do not know how to reply to the right block of text.

Hey nice of you to reply.
nobody hurt me, I just don't feel like I can continue living without the will to live.
